subject: Testing Configural invariance on a multilevel model

messages.author: c7ea9889adb627cb
messages.subject: Testing Configural invariance on a multilevel model
parts:
Hello R-colleagues, 

I try to test configural invariance on a multilvel model but I get an Error.

My model:
model1 <- "level: 1
P =~ in1
I =~ im + imo
BEW=~ bm + bmo
HaA=~ hm + hmo
D=~BEW+HaA
PUW =~ P + I + D
level: 2
in1 ~~ in1
im ~~ imo + im
imo ~~ imo
bm ~~ bmo + bm
hmo ~~ hmo
bmo ~~ bmo
hm ~~ hm + hmo"

fit1<- sem(model1, data = data1, meanstructure=TRUE, cluster = "ko", group = "mp", missing = "FIML", estimator = "MLR", std.lv = TRUE, fixed.x=FALSE)

Error Message:
Error in ov.names.l[[g]] : subscript out of bounds

Perhaps you can help me? This would be great!
Thank you in advance.

Best,
Robin

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Testing Configural invariance on a multilevel model
parts:
In multigroup single-level SEMs, lavaan will automatically apply your syntax to group-specific blocks, but multigroup MLSEMs must be specified entirely in blocks (levels nested in groups).  For an example, see the last syntax example on the semTools::reliability() help page.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Testing Configural invariance on a multilevel model
parts:
model2 <- ' group: type1
level: within fac =~ y1 + L2*y2 + L3*y3
level: between fac =~ y1 + L2*y2 + L3*y3
You need to put your model parameters on a different line than the one that specifies the level

group: type2
level: within fac =~ y1 + L2*y2 + L3*y3
level: between fac =~ y1 + L2*y2 + L3*y3
‚
The last character is a comma, not a closing quotation mark.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
